what: Cost and bias of the leak-tight 3D cascades (web/shaders/cascades3d), sixth round. Round 5 (evidence/cascades3d-leak-rtx4090.json) left J = jit 8, tf 32 on B0 plus sv 2, ft 1, cg 1: leak 0.12% to 0.40% at five placements, raw-hall 1080p RMSE 0.083 (0.078 to 0.088), bias +1.4%, but GI 6.38 to 6.66 ms against 6. cg 1 traces up to 8 segments at every hit whose depth test finds no probe (about 1.2 ms in the level pass, 0.4 to 0.7 ms in the screen rays). sv 2 alone brightens raw-hall by about 2% (bias +2.1% against B0's -0.5%)
written: 2026-11-07, after the CPU code of the switches below was written and the node unit tests passed, and before any diagnosis run, GPU run, measurement or parity run

switches.cg_2: the cache gather's fallback (no level-0 probe passes the depth-moment test) keeps the lit-side probes outside geometry whose farthest of the 4 depth rays in the texel toward the lifted point (the point plus a quarter spacing along the normal, the depth test's point) travels at least as far as the point. The depth pass already traces those rays once a jitter phase (static geometry); it now also stores each texel's nearest and farthest distance (vec4 instead of vec2). No rays at gather time; cg 1 traces up to 8
switches.cg_3: as cg 2 with the nearest of the 4 rays (all four must reach past the point): tighter, darker
switches.sd_1: with sv, a merge (level entries and screen-probe rays) weighs each trusted neighbour's dropped share (texels whose own start ray crossed a surface) back in, at the dropped texels' own mean capped per channel by the merge's trusted mean. The merge then never returns more than the trusted mean (no new light can enter), and the dark entries that sv 2 drops count again. This is a cap from the same merge, not the coarser level's value the brief named as one option: the coarser level can itself hold light from past a wall

why_leak_tight: inferred, not proven. sd: the merged value is at most the trusted mean per channel, so it adds no light the leak-tight sv 2 merge does not already carry. cg 2: a probe in room A that a thin wall separates from the point has all 4 texel rays stop at the wall, closer than the point; a ray that grazes past the end of a wall within the same texel can reach farther, which is the case the leak runs test. cg 3 removes that case at the cost of light

candidates.K: jit 8, tf 32 on B0 (h0 0.5, c0 1, r0 2, f 2, fix probe, stride 8, m 6, static flags) plus sv 2, ft 1, cg 2, sd 1: the default candidate
candidates.K3: K with cg 3 instead of cg 2, measured if K fails the leak bound or as the ablation
candidates.Kfix: K without jit and tf (B0 plus sv 2, ft 1, cg 2, sd 1), the fixed grids of K's phases for the per-phase leak test
candidates.ablations: J (round 5, cg 1) re-timed in this session as the control; J with cg 2 (no sd); J with sd (cg 1); B0 with sv 2 and sd; reported, not used for decisions except as stated below

metrics.leak_closed: leak-closed-B at 960 x 540, static flags, 20 frames: the frame's mean luminance over the room A view's reference mean (0.0501, pt-leak-closed-A-960-s1), as rounds 4 and 5
metrics.jit_phases: Kfix at g0 to g4 and at ph4 to ph7 (build/diag phases.json; phases 0 to 3 of jit 8 are g1 to g4): every phase's grid on its own
metrics.door_room: leak-door-B at 960 x 540 against 4096 spp: room B light ratio and relative error, reported
metrics.hall: raw-hall nave at 1920 x 1080 against the 8-bounce path trace (two 1024 spp seeds): relative RMSE with the 95% 32 x 32 tile bootstrap, bias, wall and floor mottle, GPU GI median and 5th to 95th percentile of 50 frames per run, three timing runs for a candidate; 4K once for a candidate that becomes the default
metrics.parity: GPU f32 against the CPU f64 reference on the existing 19 cases and new cases for cg 2, cg 3 and sd, bound 2e-3 a case (unchanged)

predictions.cpu_16x10: K's switches (sv 2, ft 1, cg 2, sd 1) on the CPU at 16 x 10 px: closed room under 0.1% at all 13 grids
predictions.leak: K under 1% at g0 to g4, worst under 0.5%; Kfix under 1% at all 9 grids
predictions.time: K's 1080p GI median 4.9 to 5.4 ms (J without cg read 5.0; sd adds arithmetic only)
predictions.hall: K's RMSE 0.078 to 0.085, bias between -1% and +1% (sd pulls J's +1.4% toward B0's -0.5%)

pass_line: a candidate passes when (a) the closed room reads under 1% at g0 to g4 and its fixed grids read under 1% at g0 to g4 and ph4 to ph7, (b) its raw-hall 1080p RMSE is at most 0.111 (B0's upper 95% limit; the target is jit's 0.080 to 0.085), and (c) the median GI time of each of three 1080p timing runs is under 6 ms. GPU parity within 2e-3 on every case

kill_line.cheap_cg: cg 2 is a null if K's (or J with cg 2's) worst closed-room placement reads above 1%, or if replacing cg 1 by cg 2 in J saves under 0.5 ms of GI median at 1080p
kill_line.sd: sd is a null if J with sd (or K against J with cg 2) does not move the raw-hall bias at least halfway from its value without sd toward zero, or raises the worst closed-room leak above 1%

decisions.default: if K (or K3 when K fails only the leak bound) passes the pass line, its switches become the default of planCascades3d in the same PR (tf 32 and jit 8 apply when screen probes run; stride 0 plans keep no jitter), with docs and the changelog saying so. Among passing candidates the lower RMSE wins; within 0.002 the lower worst leak
decisions.otherwise: keep the shipped defaults and record the nulls

budget: GPU memory under about 6 GB (shared with wmm-4 training using up to about 12 GB and a universe agent; never stop other processes; wait when the GPU is near full); at most 3 CPU workers at below-normal priority; one GPU run at a time; SwiftShader parity in CI only. Timings note that the GPU was shared
